criteria.priority_notes: Standard RIA evaluation criterion. The call scope emphasises novelty in AI agent architectures, planning mechanisms, memory management, reasoning capabilities, and multi-agent frameworks. Proposals must demonstrate scientific and technological merit in these areas.
criteria.inference_note: Explicit evaluation criterion weights are not stated in the call slice or curated extract. 'Excellence' is the standard first criterion for RIA under Horizon Europe evaluation forms. Its relevance is inferred from the instrument type (RIA) confirmed in the call slice and the detailed scope requirements.

criteria.priority_notes: The call explicitly requires contribution to the Apply AI Strategy, deployment via EDIHs, validation in Testing and Experiment Facilities, and cohesion activities with ADRA and GenAI4EU Hub. Portfolio coverage across healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving sectors is a procedural priority.
criteria.inference_note: 'Impact' is the standard second criterion for RIA under Horizon Europe evaluation forms. Its specific content is inferred from the explicit impact-related requirements in the Scope field (Apply AI Strategy contribution, EDIH deployment, AI-on-demand platform sharing) and the procedure_exceptions field (sector portfolio coverage) of the call slice and curated extract.

criteria.priority_notes: Proposals must incorporate KPIs, benchmarking, and progress monitoring mechanisms. Projects must allocate tasks for ADRA cohesion activities and GenAI4EU Hub collaboration. Building on previous funded actions and linking to AI Factories and Data Labs resources are expected.
criteria.inference_note: 'Implementation' is the standard third criterion for RIA under Horizon Europe evaluation forms. Its specific content is inferred from the explicit implementation-related requirements in the Scope field: KPI/benchmarking mandate, ADRA cohesion task allocation, AI Factories linkage, and reuse of prior funded results.

criteria.priority_notes: To ensure portfolio coverage, grants will be awarded to applications not only in order of ranking, but also to at least one proposal focusing on each of the three sectors: healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving — subject to proposals passing all evaluation thresholds.
